title: When life starts asking what it is for
issueStatement: The schedule may be full, yet the soul keeps asking what all this effort finally serves.
centralInsight: Gurbani frames human life as a chance for meeting, service, and Naam. Purpose becomes clearer when life is received as trust, not merely managed as maintenance.
practicalReflection: Loss of purpose is not always dramatic. Often it appears when daily work is no longer connected to devotion, usefulness, or the Giver.
actionPrompt: Before the next task swallows the hour, choose one act that answers life as calling rather than maintenance.

pressure.label: Under Pressure
pressure.title: When pressure makes purpose feel replaceable
pressure.issueStatement: The day is crowded and every demand starts sounding absolute. Under pressure, purpose is the first thing to collapse into urgency, so you stay busy while forgetting what the work is for.
pressure.centralInsight: Gurbani does not measure purpose by output under stress. It tests whether service, Naam, and truthful duty still survive when speed, anxiety, and ambition crowd the room.
pressure.practicalReflection: Pressure usually does not remove purpose; it exposes what you will sacrifice first. If devotion disappears whenever urgency arrives, the urgency has become your master.

repair.label: After the Slip
repair.title: When purpose has thinned into maintenance
repair.issueStatement: The thread has already slipped. Work continued, obligations were met, but the heart can no longer tell whether this life is being offered or merely managed.
repair.centralInsight: Gurbani brings purpose back through reorientation, not self-drama. The way home is usually one honest act of service, one remembered line, and one refusal to keep living below what this human life was given for.
repair.practicalReflection: Repair begins when you stop waiting for a grand calling and return to the next entrusted act with reverence. Purpose grows again when usefulness and remembrance meet.

practice.issueStatement: The schedule may be full, yet the soul keeps asking what all this effort finally serves. Inspiration is not the main need now; a repeatable return is.

practice.practicalReflection: Purpose becomes durable when it is tied to a kept rhythm of service and remembrance. The soul usually recovers its thread through repeated fidelity, not through one dramatic feeling of direction.
